one_liner: FanBasis (rebranded Commas) creator payments / merchant-of-record platform with a REST Public API for checkout sessions, products, customers, subscriptions, refunds and webhooks; x-api-key auth, free sandbox, vendor MCP.
notes: fanbasis.com now redirects to commas.com ('FanBasis is now Commas!'). commas.com has no developer link and docs.*/developers.* hosts do not exist; the API docs live at apidocs.fan ('Commas API Reference'), found via third-party integrations (laravel-payments, a WooCommerce plugin) and then confirmed as the vendor's own: it documents production base URL https://www.fanbasis.com/public-api, support@fanbasis.com, and the exact live 401 body returned by https://www.fanbasis.com/public-api/products ('Authentication required. Please provide X-API-KEY or Bearer token.'). Residual ambiguity: the docs domain is not linked from the marketing site. auth: API key from the dashboard (Account -> API Keys) in the x-api-key header; some Seller v1 endpoints take the same static key as 'Authorization: Bearer' -> api_key only. The MCP's 'OAuth login flow' is for the MCP connector, not the REST API. access: sandbox.commas.net has self-serve signup and sandbox keys, no account verification needed to build; going live needs identity verification / account approval (merchant KYC; docs show 403 'Your account is not approved by the Commas admin'), comparable to Stripe test vs live keys -> self_serve_free. mcp: vendor docs ship an MCP section (44 tools, Claude Desktop .mcpb download, Cursor one-click via mcp-remote to a railway.app endpoint; the ChatGPT remote endpoint www.fanbasis.com/mcp is marked 'Coming Soon' and currently answers 405) -> official per 'vendor docs page'.
